brief:
Israeli occupation forces continued breaching the Gaza ceasefire agreement through artillery shelling and gunfire targeting multiple areas east of the Yellow Line in the strip, Shehab Wire reported. Local sources said occupation tanks shelled several targets in zones designated outside the demarcation line separating Israeli and Palestinian positions.

The incidents represent the latest in a series of reported violations by Israeli forces since the ceasefire took effect in Gaza. Residents in affected areas reported sustained bombardment across multiple locations, with shells and gunfire impacting civilian zones east of the established boundary.
